static_correspondence.reason: C_up is rounded upward. Each matrix term uses upward integer division; z is computed from C_up itself. The scalar final-term upper and N+2>z geometric denominator bound the omitted exact positive series. Zero next-product termination implies no actual positive tail.

Down-rounded positive partial sums are lower bounds for exp(q), so their upward reciprocals are upper bounds for exp(-q). Up-rounded sums plus tail yield the lower reciprocal bound; q=0 retains exactly[1,1].

T00=Wupper00-1+rho uses exact rational subtraction. Negative d is kept for endpoint and pointwise values. Bplus changes only d to max(d,0), giving a nonnegative time-monotone comparison that covers every interior time.
